answer: Make the kernel of grading trust a pairwise agreement check. Every grader's 0-3 scores are compared with every other grader's on shared seats; when two identities agree far beyond chance, they are counted as one and their grading weight is split, so a sybil ring gains nothing by adding members. Rewards that bridge out of a flagged cluster are held one epoch and forfeited if the match holds. To dodge it, each fake must grade independently, quartz-hard work that costs as much per copy as an honest agent.
